mapper.sql:
SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.real_name, u.phone, g.last_measure_time, COALESCE(g.recent_record_count, 0) AS recent_record_count, COALESCE(g.abnormal_count, 0) AS abnormal_count, g.highest_blood_sugar, g.lowest_blood_sugar, CASE WHEN g.last_measure_time IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE DATEDIFF(#{today}, DATE(g.last_measure_time)) END AS inactive_days, LEAST( 100, CASE WHEN g.last_measure_time IS NULL OR g.last_measure_time < #{cutoff} THEN 20 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN COALESCE(g.abnormal_count, 0) >= 3 THEN 60 WHEN COALESCE(g.abnormal_count, 0) = 2 THEN 40 WHEN COALESCE(g.abnormal_count, 0) = 1 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN COALESCE(g.highest_blood_sugar, 0) >= 13.9 THEN 40 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN g.lowest_blood_sugar IS NOT NULL AND g.lowest_blood_sugar < 3.9 THEN 40 ELSE 0 END ) AS risk_score from sys_user u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, MAX(measure_time) AS last_measure_time,
SUM( CASE WHEN measure_time >= #{cutoff} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS recent_record_count,
SUM( CASE WHEN measure_time >= #{cutoff} AND ( blood_sugar < 3.9 OR ( measure_type = 1 AND blood_sugar >= 7.0 ) OR ( measure_type = 2 AND blood_sugar >= 7.0 ) OR ( measure_type = 3 AND blood_sugar >= 11.1 ) OR ( measure_type = 4 AND blood_sugar >= 10.0 ) OR ( measure_type = 5 AND blood_sugar >= 7.0 ) OR blood_sugar >= 13.9 ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS abnormal_count, MAX( CASE WHEN measure_time >= #{cutoff} THEN blood_sugar END ) AS highest_blood_sugar,
MIN( CASE WHEN measure_time >= #{cutoff} THEN blood_sugar END ) AS lowest_blood_sugar
FROM health_record_blood_sugar GROUP BY user_id ) g ON g.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.role = 0 AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1

SELECT risk_user.*, CASE WHEN risk_user.risk_score >= 60 THEN 1 WHEN risk_user.risk_score >= 30 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS risk_level, CONCAT_WS( '；', CASE WHEN risk_user.abnormal_count > 0 THEN CONCAT( '近7天异常血糖', risk_user.abnormal_count, '次' ) END, CASE WHEN risk_user.highest_blood_sugar >= 13.9 THEN '出现严重高血糖' END, CASE WHEN risk_user.lowest_blood_sugar < 3.9 THEN '出现低血糖' END, CASE WHEN risk_user.last_measure_time IS NULL THEN '从未记录血糖' WHEN risk_user.inactive_days > 7 THEN CONCAT( '已', risk_user.inactive_days, '天未记录血糖' ) END ) AS risk_reasons FROM (
) risk_user

SELECT COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN risk_user.risk_level = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS high_risk_users,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN risk_user.risk_level = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS medium_risk_users,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN risk_user.risk_level = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS observation_users,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN risk_user.inactive_days IS NULL OR risk_user.inactive_days > 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS inactive_users FROM (
) risk_user WHERE risk_user.risk_score > 0
